_comment: Keyword lists used by scout.mjs scan. Each entry: label (Japanese, shown in the report) and pattern
(a JavaScript regular expression; flags default to 'i', set "flags": "" for case-sensitive; a space also matches a line break).
privacy: flagged as 要確認 for a human to judge; never rejected automatically.
harness: text written for another tool that needs a 読み替え (要書き換え).
cliTools: command-line tools that the Microsoft 365 sandbox does not have (不可).
claudeOnly (harness entries): a Claude Code feature the sandbox cannot honour. The scout keeps it as 要書き換え; the converter (m365-skill-convert/scripts/skill2zip.mjs) stops on it unless --force.
Used by both the scout (m365-org-skills/scout) and the converter; this file is the single copy.
